prompt.text:
Implement a deterministic account directory in package solution using only the standard library.

Export:
- `type PublicAccount struct { ID, Name, Email string }`
- `type AccountStore`
- `func NewAccountStore(secret []byte) (*AccountStore, error)`
- `func (s *AccountStore) Register(name, email, password string) (PublicAccount, error)`
- `func (s *AccountStore) Authenticate(email, password string) (string, error)`
- `func (s *AccountStore) Verify(token string) (PublicAccount, error)`
- `func (s *AccountStore) FindByName(name string) []PublicAccount`

The constructor rejects an empty secret and copies it. Registration trims surrounding Unicode whitespace from names and emails, lowercases emails, rejects empty normalized names/emails, requires at least eight password bytes, and enforces normalized-email uniqueness. IDs are deterministic `u1`, `u2`, and so on, with failed registrations consuming no ID. Passwords must be stored only as SHA-256 digests incorporating the account ID; public results never expose them.

Authentication normalizes email the same way and returns a URL-safe unpadded token containing the ID plus an HMAC-SHA256 signature. It rejects missing users and wrong passwords. Verify rejects malformed, unknown, or altered tokens. FindByName compares the normalized stored name exactly and returns results sorted by ID. Returned data cannot mutate store state, and failed calls do not mutate it. Implement a new complete source file without tests.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
